action.export.summary: Write one run as ordinary files in a new project folder (default exports/<operationId>): the script that ran, from the run's own record; each declared output as the run left it; and provenance.json with PROVENANCE.md, saying where each file came from and what was checked. A declared file that was not written, or no longer matches the inventory the run wrote, is named and left out. When the script has unsaved changes, unsaved must be "include" or "leave". Runs nothing and never writes into an existing folder.

action.lookup.summary: Read the original accepted operation. Missing acknowledgement is not permission for a new identity.

action.observe.summary: Observe original Core facts. Never starts or recovers a Host.

action.submit.summary: Execute the explicitly selected project R script snapshot and requirements. Persist operationId before delivery; identical retries retain the original Core identity. Output directory is the first R argument, followed by explicit args or frozen resource paths. Artifact paths are output-relative; completion is run-directory-relative, returned as plan.completion, so an inventory can remain beside immutable producer artifacts.

artifact.check.summary: Verify the selected completion inventory and file bytes only; domain check reports remain project resources.

binding.activity.append.summary: Registered native adapter only: retain original CLI tool and artifact-ready observations. This does not execute, validate, or present artifacts.

binding.open.summary: Bind this external session to the authenticated project scope. Conversation stays in Claude Code.

capability.configure.summary: Persist the selected project plugins with a conditional version and idempotent changeId. This changes routing only; it installs no package, starts no runtime and cancels no work.

capability.index.summary: Read a small role-narrowed index of currently authorized, enabled operations and immutable Skill/contract references.

capability.list.summary: Read registered actions and components. Does not start R or a Core Host.

capability.resolve.summary: Fetch selected relevant Skills with complete owner contracts, whole objects only. Pages pin catalog/bundle/caller; knownRefs only reuse currently available immutable bodies.

composition.delete.summary: Delete an empty Studio workspace layout only, never the project directory, documents, resources, conversations or running sessions. Requires its observed expectedVersion and a stable changeId. The same request returns its original receipt without deleting a recreated workspace. Nonempty, conversation and active-task layouts are refused. The deleted layout and its history remain readable with composition.read and recoverable with composition.undo; it is omitted from active workspace lists. Recreating it uses a conditional composition.apply replacement at its retained version.

console.events.summary: Who ran each Console command and when, newest first, for the timeline: the folder, how it ended and its first line. No output.

console.list.summary: The commands run from the Console, newest first, with how each ended as Rho observed it: an exit code or signal, a requested stop, still continuing outside Rho, or unknown.

console.output.summary: One bounded page of what a Console command printed. Output past the kept size is counted in a note, not silently dropped.

console.run.summary: Person at this machine only: run a typed command with their shell in the project folder (or a folder inside it). The same changeId returns the same record and never runs the command twice. Returns once it has started; read its output with console.output.

console.stop.summary: Person at this machine only: ask a running Console command and the processes it started to stop; they are killed after a short grace period.

context.read.summary: Read an explicit versioned context package. Receipt establishes a tool fetch, not proactive delivery to a conversation.

conversation.agents.add.summary: Person at this machine only: add an ACP Agent for new conversations in every project, given its program (on PATH or a path) and arguments, such as ["hermes", "acp"]. Rho starts it once in this project to read what it offers, then removes that session and ends the process; no message is sent. It is kept only when it answered. Adding the same command again checks it again.

conversation.agents.remove.summary: Person at this machine only: remove an added ACP Agent from the Agents new conversations can use. Its conversations stay and continue with the command they started with.

conversation.configure.summary: Person at this machine only: change one setting the Agent offers (model, effort, mode…) for the next messages of a conversation started in Rho. An open session changes now; otherwise the choice is applied when the session next opens. Refused while a message is being answered.

conversation.decide.summary: Person at this machine only: say to use an answer, or that it needs changes and why. The decision holds for the file versions that message kept when it was given and says nothing of later versions. A new decision supersedes the one before; none is removed. Refused while the Agent is still answering.

conversation.delete.summary: Person at this machine only: delete Rho's record of a conversation in the trash. The Agent's own session files are not touched. Repeating the request that started it is then refused.

conversation.list.summary: Person at this machine only: list the conversations started in Rho in this project, or those in its trash, with each one's Agent, last model, choices and reported usage. Reading starts nothing.

conversation.permission.summary: Person at this machine only: record an offered choice for a pending Agent permission request. The original request identity is retained; repeated identical choices do not respond twice.

conversation.read.summary: Read a conversation started in Rho: the person's messages, the Agent's visible text and tool steps, and how each message ended. Reading starts and resumes nothing.

conversation.restore.summary: Person at this machine only: return a conversation from the trash to the project's conversations, within the project's conversation limit.

conversation.send.summary: Person at this machine only: send the next message to a conversation started in Rho. A continuationOf links a new message to the latest confirmed Agent turn-limit stop; the original request is not resent. Refused while the previous message is being answered. A repeated changeId with the same input returns the original message.

conversation.settings.check.summary: Person at this machine only: start the chosen Agent in this project to read the settings it offers, then remove that session and end the process. No message is sent; one check per Agent runs at a time.

conversation.settings.read.summary: Person at this machine only: read the Agent and settings chosen for new conversations and what each Agent last offered. Reading starts nothing.

conversation.settings.update.summary: Person at this machine only: choose the Agent and its settings for new conversations, among the values that Agent last offered, and whether a model describes the files a message writes. A stale expectedVersion is refused.

conversation.start.summary: Person at this machine only: start a conversation with the selected Claude Code or Codex Agent in this project. Rho selects the Agent plugin backend, attaches this project's MCP grant and records the message before sending it. Without backend or config, the person's saved Agent and settings are used and recorded with the conversation. A repeated changeId with the same text returns the original conversation and starts nothing. With continue, the message continues an Agent session listed by agent.sessions.list (one started in a terminal, an editor or the Agent's own app) through that same session, or through a copy of it with copy; a session another live window holds open is refused unless copied.

conversation.stop.summary: Person at this machine only: ask the original Agent to stop answering one message. ACP cancellation is confirmed by the original prompt response; a lost connection keeps the outcome unknown. Legacy CLI conversations confirm process exit. Steps already taken stay done.

conversation.trash.summary: Person at this machine only: move a conversation that is not being answered to the trash. It is kept whole and not continued until restored; an idle connection to its Agent ends.

data.compare.summary: Join two explicit table versions using declared keys, namespaces, fields and join policy. Scientific comparability remains the project responsibility.

document.edit.summary: Apply conditional UTF-16 text edits to the shared buffer; keep the returned version.

document.read.summary: Read the shared acknowledged buffer, including unsaved text and its version.

extension.call.summary: Call an enabled third-party operation at the described package digest, under the caller and project. The package runs trusted native code. Non-read calls retain the original changeId: repeat observes that invocation, including unknown outcomes, without re-execution. Completion is not scientific validity.

extension.content.summary: Read one installed plugin Skill or standalone HTML view at its selected package digest. Reading starts no plugin or runtime.

extension.describe.summary: Read an installed third-party package manifest, operation input schemas, required Rho methods, Skills and views. Read its Skill with extension.content before use. Disabled packages cannot run.

extension.install.summary: Local person/operator: install a trusted prebuilt npm package, local folder, tarball, or Git source. Lifecycle scripts are disabled. Replacement stages and checks the new package before switching; use replace and expectedDigest for updates.

extension.list.summary: List independently installed third-party packages and their enabled state, source and immutable digest. Reads start no plugin or runtime. Use extension.describe to discover operation schemas and Skills.

extension.manage.summary: Local person/operator: enable, disable or remove an installed third-party package at the expected digest. Existing native tasks, R sessions, project files and retained receipts are preserved.

extension.read.summary: Observe an original plugin invocation, including pending or unknown outcomes. Never reruns code. Only its original caller can read it.

feedback.read.summary: Original business binding only: fetch one complete frozen feedback object using its original delivery/context and a stable fetchId. relatedDocumentId is a pointer: read its CURRENT version before conditional edit/save and preserve human changes. This owner-served receipt does not prove client return or understanding.

feedback.status.summary: Observe original delivery, exact-target fetches and explicitly linked replies. No send, session start or recovery. Keep original identities and unknown outcomes; continuation cursors pin their snapshot.

feedback.submit.summary: Teacher browser only: freeze the original draft/anchor, prepare the committed message and retain one original-session delivery. Preserve submissionId across missing acknowledgements; stages are separate durable facts.

kernel.events.summary: Who ran each cell of the live sessions and when, newest first, for the timeline: its language and place, how it ended and its purpose or first line. No code or output.

kernel.inspect.summary: One value of a live session, as its session describes it: what kind of thing it is (a table, a model, a vector, a list, a function or a value), short facts, and one page of its rows, elements or parts, each part with the code that reaches it. Never starts a session or waits for a cell: while a cell runs or waits the answer is busy. A reading that takes too long is interrupted.

kernel.interrupt.summary: Interrupt one cell: a running cell stops and its session and values stay; a waiting cell is not run. A cell that has ended is returned unchanged.

kernel.place.check.summary: Connect to a place on a server and report its system, machine, the folder after its setup lines, and R and Python there. Runs the place's setup lines; starts no session.

kernel.place.copy.summary: Copy one file within a place's folder on its server into the project under remote/<place>/, with its size, time and digest, so it can be opened here. Large files stay on the server.

kernel.place.list.summary: The files in a folder within a place's folder on its server, folders first, with sizes and times. Paths leading out of the place's folder, links among them, are refused.

kernel.place.set.summary: Name a place on a remote server for live sessions (reached through serverctl or ssh, with a folder and setup lines), change or remove one, or choose where R or Python starts next. Follow the server's own skill (kernel.servers) for its folder and setup.

kernel.places.summary: Where live sessions run: this machine and the places named on the person's remote servers (a server, a folder there and the setup lines run before a session, such as module load), where each language's next session starts, and the files copied from them into the project.

kernel.plot.summary: One plot a cell kept, as PNG bytes.

kernel.read.summary: The live sessions and their cells, oldest cell first: code, purpose, who ran it, what it printed, its plots and how it ended, and each session's variables. Reading never starts a session.

kernel.run.summary: Run a cell of R or Python in the project's live session of that language, which the Agent and the person share: what one cell defines stays for the next. Starts the session when none is live, on this machine or at a place on one of the person's servers (place, or where kernel.places says that language runs next). interpreter names the program a session on this machine starts with, in a folder of the project such as .venv/bin/python; the project keeps it for that language's later sessions, and each cell records the program and version that ran it. The same changeId from the same caller returns the same cell and never runs it twice. waitMs waits for the cell to end.

kernel.server.skill.summary: One skill bound to a server, as its file reads now: how that server is used. Read it before naming a place there or running work on it.

kernel.servers.summary: The remote servers the person manages with serverctl, read from its registry now (no server is connected to), and the skills bound to each: how that server is used, its modules, data and limits.

kernel.stop.summary: Person at this machine only: end one live session. Its values are gone, the running cell ends with an error and waiting cells are not run. A session that has ended is returned unchanged.

object.read.summary: Read a bounded exported JSON object snapshot, not live R memory.

project.doctor.summary: Report whether this project can actually do work right now: Core binary, Rscript, write access to the project and state folders, plugin selection, Host socket and unfinished runs. Each check carries the next action when it does not pass. It starts no Host and changes nothing.

project.entries.summary: List one level of a folder in this project: ordinary files and folders, bounded and confined to that folder, excluding owner state. The project folder lists the source folders it works in as @<sourceId> entries, which descend like any other folder. Listing reads no file contents and starts no runtime.

project.openFile.summary: Open one text file from the selected project as a document and place it in the person's own layout in one conditional step, so a person can see and edit their own source files without an Agent. Accepts a project-relative path or the @<sourceId>/<path> reference the listing returns; it executes nothing.

project.runs.summary: Report what this project has run and what it is running: one bounded summary per operation with its execution state, accepted time, author kind, the artifact paths its plan declared, whether each of those files is on disk now, whether the producer wrote a completion inventory, and the recorded integrity and domain states. A declaration, a file on disk and a verified artifact are separate facts. It carries no request body, no code and no output text, and starts nothing.

project.work.read.summary: Person at this machine only: read linked Agent sessions, retained native activity identities, current referenced files and the shared notes document. Source cursors and resource versions remain independent. Does not start an Agent, collector or Host.

protocol.validate.summary: Check one operation body against its versioned schema without executing it: the same checks the server applies, reported with the edit each problem needs. Use it before a write whose shape is uncertain; it changes nothing and starts nothing.

requirements.check.summary: Probe only the explicitly declared R packages with bounded base R; no Core Host or project script starts.

resource.register.summary: Declare scoped existing bytes and their type/schema at the supplied digest. This read and registration starts no runtime.

session.connect.summary: Person at this machine only: give Claude Code or Codex running outside Rho access to this project, then add Rho's MCP server with that Agent's own `mcp add` (Claude Code: for this project folder; Codex: in its user configuration). A grant whose connection still reaches this service is kept, so a connected session keeps working; a new grant the Agent refuses is removed. No message is sent and no Agent session starts.

session.instructions.summary: Person at this machine or operator only: read a prompt for the person's own MCP client to connect itself to this existing project. Returns local launcher paths, never credential contents. Reading or copying grants no access, edits no client configuration and starts no runtime.

skill.list.summary: List the application and enabled provider Skills shipped in the selected package. Skills guide discovery but do not grant authorization.

skill.read.summary: Read one versioned shipped Skill after checking its digest. A stale digest requires rereading instead of applying cached instructions.

skills.change.summary: Record in a project skill when the person corrects a method or says how they work, or a failure's cause and fix are found: a new skill, a new text with a one-sentence reason and evidence, or its removal. Record how to work, never results. Made on the version read; the same changeId never writes twice.

skills.list.summary: The project's skills: how work is done here (the methods the person chose, the conventions they keep, the traps its work ran into), each a SKILL.md in .claude/skills that every Agent here reads, with what it is for and its newest change. Read before analysing.

skills.read.summary: One project skill's text and its changes, newest first: who made each, why, from what (cells, conversations, files) and the lines it added and removed, and what changed outside Rho since.

skills.undo.summary: Put a project skill back as it was before its newest change, while the file is still as that change left it. The undo is a change of its own.

task.map.declare.summary: Agent only: conditionally declare task items, your own kind/state vocabulary (label, tone, optional role) and the next steps you will take. Rho shows next only from this declaration and never infers it.

task.map.present.summary: Change a map placement or item card form, its parameters (including a subset) or the focus. Shared by the Agent and people. An Agent change to a pinned target, or within agentFormIntervalMs of its last applied form change, is merged into one pending suggestion instead of applied; Agent changes stay attributed and revertible.

task.map.read.summary: Observe the task map: declared items, vocabulary, next steps, forms, pins and pending suggestions. Reading starts, resumes or reruns nothing.

task.map.respond.summary: Browser person only: pin or unpin what they see, revert an Agent form change (layout only, never the work), or accept/dismiss a pending suggestion.

task.routing.put.summary: Control plane only: conditionally assign one task and business binding to this project without starting a native session.

workspace.enhance.summary: Assigned presenter only: conditional display emphasis/title/plain Agent note using exact current generation, witness and observation. Does not modify business resources, feedback or protection.

workspace.observe.summary: Assigned presenter only: bounded layout/basis/owner summary/visibility projection. No feedback, full documents or native trace. Reading starts no model or renderer.
